description: Error messages the stack logs on purpose. Each rule mutes the matching findings from `bun run factory findings`, so they are never filed as issues. Fields: service (a name, * matches any run of characters), match (a case-insensitive regular expression tested against the whole message), reason (required: why the stack logs it on purpose).

rules.match: the database system is shutting down
rules.reason: On a fresh volume the postgres image starts a temporary server to run its init scripts, then stops it; a health check that connects in that moment gets this. A real crash logs its own error first.
